page.description: The channels your conversations come through. Each one shows what's going on and what to do when something needs you.
page.emptyDescription: Connect your WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger or website chat to start receiving conversations here.

empty.attention: Nothing needs your attention right now.
empty.off: No channels paused or turned off.

alerts.dismissDescription: Everyone in the organization stops seeing this alert, and the number in the menu goes down. Dismissing doesn't reconnect the channel: if the problem persists, it stays here.

pending.label: Waiting
pending.hint: Scan the code on your phone to finish connecting.

paused.label: Paused
paused.hint: Automation is stopped. Resume whenever you like.
paused.hintDiscards: Automation is stopped, and whatever arrives while the channel is paused is discarded.

failed.label: Failed
failed.hint: The connection didn't work. Try again.

closed.label: Disconnected
closed.hint: Messages aren't coming through. Connect again to keep answering here.

reject.label: Blocked
reject.hint: WhatsApp blocked this number, and it won't come back on its own. Check the number on your phone before connecting again.

inactive.label: Off
inactive.hint: This channel doesn't send or receive messages while it's off.

pause.summary: Stops automation until you resume. The connection itself stays up.
pause.summaryDiscards: Stops the channel until you resume. On this connection, whatever arrives during the pause is discarded.
pause.title: Pause {{name}}?
pause.discards: Automation stops answering and, on this connection, everything that arrives during the pause is discarded and doesn't come back. Those messages won't show up in your conversations. To keep receiving them, leave the channel on.
pause.keeps: Automation stops answering until you resume. Messages keep arriving in your conversations.

reload.summary: Restarts the link with WhatsApp without scanning the code again. Helps when messages stop coming in.
reload.title: Reload the connection for {{name}}?
reload.description: The link with WhatsApp restarts and comes back in a few seconds. You don't need to scan the code again.

shutdown.summary: Ends the connection. To come back, you have to connect again.
shutdown.title: Turn off {{name}}?
shutdown.description: The channel stops sending and receiving messages right now, and the organization gets an alert. Conversations are kept. To come back, you have to connect again.

disconnect.summary: Ends the connection with the account. To come back, you have to connect again.
disconnect.summaryInstagram: Removes Vekoo's access to your Instagram account. To come back, you have to sign in again.
disconnect.title: Disconnect {{name}}?
disconnect.description: The channel stops sending and receiving messages right now, and the organization gets an alert. Conversations are kept. To come back, you have to connect again.
disconnect.instagram: Direct messages stop coming in, Vekoo loses access to your Instagram account and the organization gets an alert. Conversations are kept. To come back, you have to sign in with the account again.

errors.generic: Something went wrong on our side. Try again in a moment.
errors.network: We can't reach the server. Check your internet and try again.
errors.forbidden: Your permission group doesn't allow this. Talk to whoever manages the organization.
errors.actionFailed: The service behind this channel didn't respond. Try again in a moment.
errors.typeMismatch: This kind of channel doesn't have this action.

choose.title: Where do your conversations come from?
choose.unavailable: This connection hasn't been set up in this environment yet.
choose.widgetCreated: Website chat created. Customize it and turn it on when you're ready.
choose.widgetFailed: We couldn't create the website chat

whatsapp.title: WhatsApp on your phone
whatsapp.description: Use the number you already have, like WhatsApp Web. You scan a QR code or type a code on your phone.

whatsapp_cloud.title: Official WhatsApp
whatsapp_cloud.description: Meta's official connection, for businesses with a business account. Lets you send approved message templates.

instagram.title: Instagram
instagram.description: Receive Direct messages from a professional account. No Facebook page needed.

messenger.title: Messenger
messenger.description: Receive messages from your Facebook page. If it has a professional Instagram, that comes along too.

widget.title: Website chat
widget.description: A chat button on your website or online store. You customize it and paste a code on the page.

method.title: How do you want to connect?
method.titleReconnect: How do you want to connect again?
method.label: Way to connect
method.qrHint: You point your phone's camera at this screen.
method.qrHintMobile: Needs another screen: a phone can't scan a code shown on itself. Open this page on a computer.
method.code: Type a code on your phone
method.codeHint: Enter the number and type the 8-letter code in WhatsApp. Good if you're on that phone right now.
method.phoneHint: With area code. Outside Brazil, start with + and the country code.
method.phoneInvalid: Check the number: some digits are missing.
method.need: Keep your phone nearby, with WhatsApp open and online. It takes less than a minute.

live.title: Connect your WhatsApp
live.qrLead: Follow the steps on your phone. As soon as you scan the code, this screen lets you know.
live.codeLead: Type this code in WhatsApp on your phone. As soon as it connects, this screen lets you know.
live.leftWaiting: The channel is still waiting. To finish, come back here and tap Continue connecting.
live.connectedWithNumber: The number {{number}} is already sending and receiving messages.
live.connectedHint: The device is linked and already sending and receiving messages.
live.failedHint: It may be a temporary problem with the WhatsApp service. Try again; if it persists, contact support and show the detail below.
live.failedHintPlain: The connection ended before it finished. Try again; if it persists, contact support.
live.blockedHint: Open WhatsApp on your phone and see what it says. Once that's sorted out, try connecting again.
live.expiredHeading: Time to scan the code ran out
live.expiredHint: For security, the code is only valid for a short time. Generate another one when you have your phone in hand.
live.useQr: I'd rather scan the QR code
live.starting: Asking WhatsApp for a new code…
live.waitingQr: Generating the QR code. It usually takes a few seconds.
live.waitingCode: Asking WhatsApp for the code. It usually takes a few seconds.
live.slow: This is taking longer than usual. You can wait a bit more or generate a new code.
live.waitingScan: Waiting for the scan. If the code changes, just scan the new one.
live.waitingEntry: Waiting for you to type the code on your phone.
live.polling: No real-time connection right now. We keep checking every few seconds.

android: Tap the menu (⋮) and Linked devices.
Point the camera at the QR code.
iphone: Go to Settings and Linked Devices.
Point the camera at the QR code.

android: Copy the code and open WhatsApp.
Tap the menu (⋮) and Linked devices.
Tap Link a device, then Link with phone number instead.
iphone: Copy the code and open WhatsApp.
Go to Settings and Linked Devices.
Tap Link a Device, then Link with phone number instead.

tips.title: To keep the connection up
tips.description: WhatsApp may disconnect the number if these are missing.
tips.internet: Keep your phone connected to the internet at all times.
tips.weeklyOpen: Open WhatsApp on your phone at least once a week.
tips.autoUpdate: Keep automatic updates for WhatsApp on in your app store.
tips.battery: Keep your phone charged: battery saver can drop the connection.
tips.linkedDevices: Don't remove this device from WhatsApp's Linked Devices list.
tips.sectionDescription: This connection depends on your phone.

webhook.title: Last step: paste these in the Meta dashboard
webhook.description: Under Webhook configuration, in the app dashboard. Copy them now: they only show up here.

meta.providerRefusedHint: Check that the account has access to the number and try again. If it persists, contact support and show the detail below.
meta.cancelled: The window was closed before finishing
meta.cancelledHint: Nothing was connected. Try again and go all the way through in the Meta window.
meta.incomplete: Meta didn't send back all the data
meta.incompleteHint: Authorization finished, but the number's data was missing. Try again.
meta.unconfigured: This connection hasn't been set up yet
meta.unconfiguredHint: This environment doesn't have the Meta app details yet. Talk to whoever manages the platform.
meta.noInstagram: The page has no professional Instagram linked, so Direct wasn't added. Link one in Meta Business Suite and connect again to receive messages from there.
meta.authorizing: Continue in the Meta window. This screen waits for you to finish.
meta.loadFailed: We couldn't open the connection with Meta. An ad blocker may be preventing it; turn it off on this page and try again.

whatsapp.title: Connect official WhatsApp
whatsapp.doneHint: The channel is already sending and receiving messages.
steps: A Meta window will open. If it doesn't, allow pop-ups for this site in your browser.
Sign in with the Facebook account that manages the business.
Choose the WhatsApp account and the number that will answer.
When you're done, the window closes and the connection finishes here.

messenger.title: Connect Messenger
messenger.doneHint: The page is already sending and receiving messages.
steps: A Facebook window will open. If it doesn't, allow pop-ups for this site in your browser.
Sign in with the account that manages the page.
Authorize access to the page's messages.
When you're done, the window closes and the connection finishes here.

instagram.title: Connect Instagram
instagram.closed: The window was closed before finishing
instagram.closedHint: Nothing was connected. Try again and go all the way through in the Instagram window.
instagram.deniedHint: Nothing was connected. To receive Direct messages here, try again and authorize access in the Instagram window.
instagram.refusedHint: The account needs to be professional (business or creator). Check that in the app and try again.
instagram.authorizing: Continue in the Instagram window. This screen waits for you to finish.
steps: An Instagram window will open. If it doesn't, the whole page goes there and comes back afterwards.
Sign in with the business's professional account.
When you're done, the connection finishes here.

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: The account's public details, as they appear on Instagram.
profile.stale: We couldn't refresh right now. Showing the last saved details.

callback.doneHint: You can close this window and go back to Vekoo. If the connection doesn't finish on its own, use the button below.

signature.label: Sign with the name of whoever answered
signature.hint: Messages sent by your team go out with the person's name, so the contact knows who they're talking to.

detail.notFoundHint: It may have been removed, or the link is wrong.
detail.generalDescription: How the channel behaves in conversations.
detail.actionsDescription: What you can do with this channel right now.

numbers.description: The numbers registered on this account. The primary one is used by default to send messages.
numbers.refreshFailed: We couldn't fetch the numbers from Meta
numbers.emptyHint: Refresh to fetch this account's numbers from Meta.

profile.loadError: We couldn't read the profile from Meta
profile.loadErrorHint: The profile doesn't open unless the Meta connection is working. If the channel is disconnected, connect it again first.
profile.pictureHint: JPEG or PNG, up to 5 MB. Shown to anyone chatting with this number.
profile.pictureType: Use a JPEG or PNG image.
profile.pictureSize: The image is over 5 MB. Try a smaller one.
profile.title: Business profile
profile.description: What contacts see when they open your profile on WhatsApp.
profile.aboutHint: The short line under the name.
profile.descriptionPlaceholder: Say in a few lines what the business does
profile.urlInvalid: Use a full address, starting with https://.

templates.description: The ready-made messages official WhatsApp lets you send outside the 24-hour window. Meta approves each one, and only approved ones can be sent.
templates.emptyHint: Create the first one to reach contacts outside the 24-hour window.
templates.deleteDescription: The template leaves your WhatsApp account at Meta, and this can't be undone. Campaigns using this template can no longer send it.
templates.created: Template sent to Meta for approval
templates.categoryChanged: Meta considers this template to be in the {{category}} category.
templates.serverErrors: Meta didn't accept this template. Review and try again:
templates.name: Name
templates.nameHint: Just for you to identify it. Contacts don't see it.
templates.lockedHint: Meta doesn't let you change the name, category and language after creating.

header.title: Header
header.hint: Text, image, video, document or location, above the message.

mediaHint.IMAGE: A public link to a JPEG or PNG image, up to 5 MB. Meta uses it as a sample for review.
mediaHint.VIDEO: A public link to an MP4 or 3GPP video, up to 16 MB. Meta uses it as a sample for review.
mediaHint.DOCUMENT: A public link to a PDF, Word, Excel or PowerPoint file, up to 100 MB. Meta uses it as a sample for review.

body.title: Message
body.placeholder: Hi, Maria! Your order is out for delivery.
body.hint: To personalize, write {{first}} and {{second}} where the name or other data goes.
body.examplesHint: Meta asks for a sample of each variable to review the template. Contacts don't see these samples.

footer.title: Footer
footer.hint: A smaller line at the end, like the store name.

buttons.title: Buttons
buttons.hint: Up to 3 buttons under the message.
buttons.urlHint: For a link that changes per contact, end it with {{variable}}.
buttons.urlExampleHint: Meta asks for a sample to review the template. Contacts don't see it.
buttons.rules: {{count}} of {{max}} buttons. At most 1 call and 2 links, and quick replies stay together.

preview.title: Preview
preview.hint: What the contact sees, with samples in place of variables.
preview.empty: The preview shows up here as you write.

validation.example: Give a sample for this variable.
validation.buttonsRequired: Add at least one button, or remove this part.
validation.buttonUrl: Use a full address, starting with https://.
validation.buttonUrlExample: Give a full sample, starting with https://.

basics.name: Name in the chat

basics.preChatHint: Visitors fill this in before sending their first message.

presets.description: A starting point: colors and shape change all at once, and you adjust what you like.

images.description: They apply as soon as you upload.
images.launcherHint: Square, shown as a circle. JPEG, PNG, WebP or GIF, up to 2 MB.
images.avatarHint: Shown at the top of the chat. JPEG, PNG, WebP or GIF, up to 2 MB.

images.invalidType: Use a JPEG, PNG, WebP or GIF image.

limits.title: Limits
limits.description: They protect against abuse from website visitors. In daily limits, 0 means no limit.
limits.dailyMessagesHint: In total. Once the limit is reached, new messages are refused until the next day.
limits.dailyVisitorsHint: People who already chatted aren't affected.

install.title: Installation code
install.description: Paste it on every page of the website, before </head>. After that, just turn on the chat.
install.notReady: The code shows up here as soon as the chat has a key.
install.regenerateHint: You only need to change the key if the code leaked. Visitors drop off until the new code is in.
install.regenerateDescription: The installed code stops working now, and visitors drop off until you paste the new code. Only do this if the key leaked.
install.regenerated: Key changed. Paste the new code on the website.

delivery.title: Chat updates
delivery.description: For security teams that review the code before it goes on the website.
delivery.label: Chat version
delivery.rollingHint: Always the latest version, and fixes arrive on their own.
delivery.pinnedHint: Freezes on one version, with an integrity check. Nothing changes without review. Colors and texts keep coming from here.
delivery.pendingSave: Save to generate the code for this version. Changing a pinned version requires pasting the code on the website again.
delivery.csp: Suggested security policy for your website

guide.title: Website chat guide
guide.description: For whoever takes care of the website.
installSteps: Copy the code on the Installation tab.
Paste it before </head> on every page of the website.
Under Security and limits, list the website's addresses.
Turn on the chat. The button shows up for visitors.
guide.cssIntro: The CSS goes inside the chat, without affecting the website. Rules with @import, expression(), behavior: and javascript: are blocked, and the limit is 8 KB. Prefer these variables, which don't change between versions:
guide.pinnedText: A pinned version always loads the same file, checked by the integrity hash: nothing changes without review. Changing versions requires pasting the code again. The suggested security policy lists what your website needs to allow for the chat to work.
limits: Messages can have up to 4,000 characters.
The limits on this screen apply to everyone visiting the website.
With context capture on, the page address and title go along with the conversation. If your addresses contain personal data, talk to support before turning on the chat.
